claimBoundary: the linked dense module is a bounded block-separated composition of two digest-pinned dense ALM weight modules. It links their typed manifests through the module linker, offsets residual slots and keyed channels to avoid collision, materializes one composed dense module, and conformance-replays projected output rows against each source dense module. It is not a trained transformer, does not claim softmax semantics, does not settle purchases, and is valid only for deterministic replay inside the numeric exactness window
